principles: Never clobber uncommitted work: only allow DONE when dirty paths don't overlap the merge's change set
Require only the merge's affected paths clean, not the whole tree
Minimal change to assertMainWorktreeReadyForMerge; preserve B-e74e's availability handling
drivers: Shared-main-worktree contention blocks unrelated stories' DONE (B-e791 blocked by B-0414)
The clean precondition is over-broad (whole tree vs the merge's paths)

options.name: A: scope the clean-check to the merge's affected paths
cons: Must correctly compute the affected path set incl. renames

options.name: B: merge via a temp index without dirtying the working tree
cons: Bigger change to the DONE merge mechanism; higher risk

chosen: A: scope the clean-check to the merge's affected paths
rationale: Option A intersects the dirty tracked paths with the merge's affected path set (git diff main...HEAD --name-only) and blocks only on overlap, so unrelated uncommitted work no longer blocks DONE while clobber-protection is preserved. It's minimal, keeps B-e74e's availability handling, and is byte-identical on a clean tree. B is a bigger merge-mechanism rewrite; C keeps the contention.

preMortem.scenario: Affected-path computation misses a path the merge would touch
preMortem.consequence: the merge clobbers a dirty file that should have blocked
preMortem.mitigation: compute affected = git diff main...HEAD --name-only including rename old+new names; block on any intersection; test overlapping-dirty still blocks

preMortem.trigger: the narrowing accidentally removes the availability check
preMortem.consequence: DONE proceeds when main worktree is unavailable
preMortem.mitigation: keep the availability check intact; only scope the dirty-path test; test main-unavailable still fails

preMortem.trigger: untracked or ignored files counted/uncounted wrongly
preMortem.mitigation: preserve --untracked-files=no (tracked only); test clean and ignored cases unchanged

preMortem.scenario: Concurrent merge changes the affected set mid-check
preMortem.trigger: another session merges to main between the check and the merge
preMortem.mitigation: the DONE merge is under the main-write-lock (B-f60c); check + merge are serialized; B-9177 hardens lock coverage further
